zh.title: 感恩節航班大減44%：美聯航單日3,102架次暫居全球最大航空公司
zh.summary: 受感恩節航班縮減影響，美聯航11月26日預計飛航3,102架次、覆蓋335座機場，單日超越美航成為全球最大航空公司；全美當日航班較前一週減少44%。
body: 感恩節將至，美國航空市場將出現大幅縮減。根據OAG數據，11月26日全美預計僅有14,993班客運航班，較前一個週四減少44%，共取消11,568班航班；國內線減幅達47%，國際線僅減少11%。
平日以飛機起降架次計全球最大的美航，當日航班較前一週大減57%，預計僅飛航3,007架次、覆蓋322座機場，排名跌至全球第3。美聯航僅減少44%，預計飛航3,102架次、覆蓋335座機場，單日登頂全球第1；美聯航當日最繁忙樞紐為休士頓洲際機場，預計725架次。
同日全球最繁忙機場也將易主：廣州白雲國際機場預計1,516架次起降，超越歐海爾、亞特蘭大、達拉斯／沃斯堡、丹佛與夏洛特，成為當日全球第1；歐海爾機場將於11月27日重回榜首。廉航方面，忠實航空航班大減68%，僅剩154架次；微風航空減少59%，僅126架次。

en.title: United Airlines to be world's largest carrier for one day as Thanksgiving cuts US flights 44%
en.summary: OAG data shows United will operate 3,102 movements to 335 airports on Thanksgiving Day, November 26, overtaking American Airlines for a single day as US schedules shrink 44% from the prior Thursday.
body: Thanksgiving is nearly here, and the US schedule will shrink sharply. OAG data shows 14,993 scheduled passenger services on November 26, down 44% from the prior Thursday, with 11,568 flights removed. Domestic activity falls 47%, against an 11% reduction internationally.

American Airlines, ordinarily the world's largest carrier by aircraft movements, will see activity fall 57% on the day to 3,007 movements across 322 airports, dropping it to third globally. United Airlines, down a comparatively modest 44%, will operate 3,102 movements to 335 airports, making it the world's largest airline for one day only. Houston Intercontinental, with 725 movements, overtakes Chicago O'Hare (ORD) and Denver as United's most-served hub.

The airport ranking will also change: Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport (CAN) will be the world's busiest airport on November 26 with 1,516 movements, ahead of O'Hare, Atlanta, Dallas/Fort Worth, Denver and Charlotte, while O'Hare returns to the top spot on November 27. Allegiant cuts deepest among the top 20 US carriers, down 68% to 154 movements, and Breeze falls 59% to 126.

zh.title: 美國航空波音777航班駐紮羅利—達拉姆：繞過夏洛特樞紐的跨大西洋高收益航線
zh.summary: 美國航空在距離第二大樞紐夏洛特僅約209公里的羅利—達拉姆機場，以一架波音777-200ER全年每日直飛倫敦希斯洛，靠研究三角園區的高收益商務客與高價值醫藥貨運支撐這條非典型的點對點航線。
body: 美國航空第二大樞紐夏洛特道格拉斯國際機場距羅利—達拉姆國際機場僅約209公里，但美國航空仍以一架273座波音777-200ER，在羅利—達拉姆至倫敦希斯洛（LHR）航線提供全年每日直飛服務。AA174航班每年載運約14萬人次海外旅客，載客率維持在七成五以上；相較之下，夏洛特約七成旅客為轉機客。羅利—達拉姆航線是北卡羅來納州往歐洲最大的本地客源市場，客源來自研究三角園區的製藥、生技與科技企業商務客，他們經常以全額票價購買旗艦商務艙。

支撐這條航線的另一支柱是腹艙貨運。波音777-200ER腹艙容積達150.9立方米，可裝載32個LD3貨櫃，比波音787-8多裝4個，用於運送溫控生技貨物、藥品原料與精密醫療器材，研究三角園區的輝瑞、必治妥施貴寶與葛蘭素史克等藥廠皆仰賴這條直飛通道。美國航空直接擁有777-200ER機隊，無須支付租賃或貸款成本，加上機上37個平躺式旗艦商務艙、24個特選經濟艙與212個經濟艙座位，使老舊機型在高燃油成本下仍具獲利能力。即使羅利當地沒有維修備件與備用機，零件須自樞紐調度，低持有成本仍足以吸收偶發的維修中斷。美國航空目前擁有47架現役777-200ER，並已投資客艙改裝，計畫讓機隊服役至2030年代。

en.title: Why American Airlines stations a Boeing 777 at Raleigh-Durham for London instead of routing through Charlotte
en.summary: American Airlines flies a 273-seat Boeing 777-200ER daily, year-round, from Raleigh-Durham to London Heathrow, even though its second-largest hub at Charlotte is only about 130 miles away. High-yield corporate traffic from Research Triangle Park and high-value pharmaceutical cargo make the point-to-point route pay.
body: Despite American Airlines' second-largest hub just 130 miles (209 km) away at Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT), the carrier operates daily, year-round transatlantic service on a 273-seat Boeing 777-200ER from Raleigh-Durham International Airport (RDU) to London Heathrow (LHR). Flight AA174 carries about 140,000 overseas passengers a year at a load factor of 75% or higher, while roughly 70% of Charlotte's traffic is made up of connecting flyers. RDU-LHR ranks as North Carolina's largest local origin-and-destination market to Europe, driven by pharmaceutical, biotechnology and technology companies in Research Triangle Park whose executives regularly pay full fare for Flagship Business seats.

The second pillar is belly cargo. The Boeing 777-200ER's lower hold offers 5,330 cubic feet (150.9 cubic meters), room for 32 LD3 containers, four more than a Boeing 787-8, and carries temperature-sensitive biotech freight, active drug ingredients and precision medical hardware for companies such as Pfizer, Biogen and GSK. American owns its 777-200ER fleet outright, paying no monthly lease or loan bills, and the cabin's 37 lie-flat Flagship Business suites, 24 premium economy recliners and 212 Main Cabin seats keep the veteran jet profitable despite higher fuel burn. Even though Raleigh has no maintenance reserves or spare airframes, so parts must be flown in from a hub when technical delays occur, low ownership costs cushion occasional disruptions. American has 47 active 777-200ERs and has invested in interior modifications to keep them flying well into the 2030s; the smaller 777-8 could eventually succeed the type, while the Airbus A321XLR cannot replace it because it lacks the underfloor space for palletized pharmaceutical cargo.

zh.title: 荷蘭 Elysian 完成新一輪募資 推進電動航空器研發
zh.summary: Elysian 在鹿特丹宣佈完成 A 輪前募資，AeroTime 報導金額為1,200萬歐元。
body: 荷蘭電動航空器開發商 Elysian Aircraft 11月19日在鹿特丹舉行的 NEDS 展會宣佈，已完成 A 輪前募資。公司列出的投資方包括 FideFlux、SecFund、ROM InWest 及個人投資者。AeroTime 報導本輪募資金額為1,200萬歐元。
公司正在開發名為 E9X 的電池電動客機，設計目標約為90座、最遠飛行1,000公里。公司也提到，一個由 Elysian 和荷蘭航太研究中心共同領導的團隊已獲荷蘭國防部研究計畫。
Elysian 表示，將在未來數月推進技術、商業及財務里程碑，並計畫於2027年展開 A 輪募資。

en.title: Elysian completes pre-Series A round to advance electric aircraft development
en.summary: The Dutch developer announced the financing at NEDS in Rotterdam. AeroTime put the round at €12 million.
body: Dutch electric aircraft developer Elysian Aircraft said on November 19 that it had closed a pre-Series A funding round. It named FideFlux, SecFund and ROM InWest among its investors. AeroTime reported the round was worth €12 million.

The company is developing its E9X battery-electric aircraft concept, with targets of about 90 passengers and up to 1,000 kilometres of range. It also cited a Dutch defence ministry research award to a group it co-leads with the Netherlands Aerospace Centre.
Elysian plans to advance technical, commercial and financial milestones and prepare for a Series A round in 2027.
